reviewed_by: Claude: tool-slot starvation fix, focused Core selection
reason: Control-plane built-ins (work_*, agent messages, notes.write, tool_catalog.search/load, goal.complete) skip the process and host tool pools via ToolSpec.uses_execution_capacity; other tools report tool_queued/tool_admitted and a queued ledger row while waiting, and a wait past NEBULA_TOOL_CAPACITY_WAIT_SECONDS (default 600) fails the call with CapacityReached before it runs. The new regression file proves the exempt tool runs with every slot held, the queued event and ledger state for the process and host pools, and the bounded wait. Existing capacity, tool-loop, catalog, agent-message and Work files cover the changed broker call sites and spec definitions.
exclusions: No UI change: the live tool card still renders tool_started as running and ignores the new tool_queued/tool_admitted events; the durable queued step uses the existing activity-ledger queued status. No frontend, native or Playwright tests apply. The harness tool gateway does not use these pools. No full-suite approval.
